title: Fans, food and "Sadda Haq" at 2:30 am
situation: Overnight at the site: bamboo hand fans handed out on entry and deposited on exit, volunteers fanning sleepers, food packets via human chain at 3 am, someone sings "Sadda Haq" at 2:30 am, dawn at 4.

lines.text: When you enter the site, a pankha is given, and when you leave the protest site, one deposits it back.
lines.speaker: volunteer

lines.text: The night ends, but the protest doesn't.
lines.speaker: Nikhil (protester)

music: "Sadda Haq" (Rockstar, 2011), sung live. Wikipedia also lists "Azadi" (Divine, Dub Sharma) and "Boom Shaka" (KR$NA, Dhanda Nyoliwala) as protest songs.

buildThis.situation: Ravi runs the pankha deposit desk; hand fans are a real inventory, and when they run out at noon people start fainting.
